text: DEFERRED SCOPE EXPANSION: Copilot review finding on PR #408 — use openat-with-directory-fd (openat2) for full directory-hop TOCTOU closure in checkpoint_readnofollow_unix.go. Current O_NOFOLLOW-on-leaf implementation matches the approved plan (EvalSymlinks/O_NOFOLLOW per component) and the existing core.readFileNoFollow pattern. Using openat2 is a deeper hardening beyond 153.001-T S1 U1 scope. Reason out of scope: P-021 C1 — fixing requires changes beyond completing the exact already-authorized change (U1 approved O_NOFOLLOW-on-leaf approach). Source refs: task=153.001-T, feature=153-F, shipment=135-S, PR=#408, review-thread=PRRT_kwDORzozKM6fAY31. Requires deliberation: true. Kind: security. Priority: medium (provisional).

DEFERRED SCOPE EXPANSION: Copilot review thread PRRT_kwDORzozKM6fDmom on PR #408 — CleanupCheckpoints classifies eligibility with readCheckpointFileNoFollow then archives via os.Rename on the original path. A concurrent writer replacing the file between read and rename could cause archiving of the wrong file. This is a pre-existing TOCTOU in CleanupCheckpoints (not introduced by U1 symlink hardening). Fix requires content re-verification at rename boundary (similar to moveNoReplace's bytes.Equal check) or handle-relative rename. Reason out of scope: P-021 C1 — U1's contract is symlink rejection in read verbs; addressing file-replacement TOCTOU in cleanup exceeds that scope. Source refs: task=153.001-T, feature=153-F, shipment=135-S, PR=#408, review-thread=PRRT_kwDORzozKM6fDmom. Requires deliberation: true. Kind: bug. Priority: medium (provisional).

DEFERRED SCOPE EXPANSION: Add null-aware presence checks for status/created_at/updated_at fields before defaulting in the legacy upgrade dry-run. json.Unmarshal converts null JSON values to Go zero-values ('', zero time), making them indistinguishable from absent fields; memory.go:344-352 then defaults them. Present-but-null members should be classified as invalid (not defaultable) per the plan contract. Add presence/type-aware checks and tests for null status/timestamps.
